name: Microsoft Entra Workload ID
short_description: Microsoft Entra Workload ID covers the identities used by software such as applications, services, scripts and containers, including app registrations, service principals and managed identities, and the tools to secure them.

evidence.quote: And that brings us to Microsoft Entra Workload Identities
Entra has a clearer model for workload identities and non-human identities.
